paragraphs: From Gorey Test Centre pull out of Clonattin Road and continue for just under a kilometre.
At the end of the road turn left onto Coach Road and head to the roundabout.
Take a full U-turn at the roundabout to come back along Coach Road.
Turn left onto Arklow Road and drive down towards the town.
Take the next right onto Main Street.
Take the 1st right onto John Street which leads onto Fort Road.
Turn left off Fort Road into Coislinne, keep right within the estate and follow it around.
Coming out of Coislinne turn left onto North Parade.
Continue straight ahead where the road becomes The Avenue.
At the roundabout take the exit left onto Railway Road.
Turn left onto Wexford Street.
Turn left into Church Lane for a tight town-centre manoeuvre.
Follow Church Lane as it becomes Market Street on the right.
Turn left onto Main Street and take the 1st right onto North Parade.
Take the next right into Cluanin, then right onto Fort Road.
Turn left onto Pearse Street and keep right as it becomes Rafter Street.
Turn left onto Main Street and slight right onto Esmonde Street.
At the roundabout on Esmonde Street take the exit left onto Coach Road.
Turn right onto Clonattin Road.
Turn right into Clonattin Village, follow it around with a U-turn included and work your way back out.
Further along Clonattin Road turn left into Clonattin Estate for a second estate section with another U-turn.
Exit Clonattin Estate back onto Clonattin Road.
Use Oak Ridge for a quick turnabout before rejoining Clonattin Road.
At the end of the road turn left onto Coach Road.
At the roundabout take the exit right onto Esmonde Street.
Take a slight left onto Main Street.
Turn right onto North Parade to return toward the Gorey Test Centre, finishing on the left.
